# Laos Travel Guide

> A Beyond Guide Network publication for a first trip to Laos. Towns, the Laos-China Railway, visa notes, and Lao dishes.

## Destinations
- [Destinations](https://laos-travelguide.com/destinations/): The towns in this edition
- [Luang Prabang](https://laos-travelguide.com/luang-prabang/): Temples, Kuang Si, and the night market
- [Vientiane](https://laos-travelguide.com/vientiane/): That Luang, Patuxai, and Wattay
- [Vang Vieng](https://laos-travelguide.com/vang-vieng/): Karst lagoons on the railway
- [4000 Islands](https://laos-travelguide.com/4000-islands/): Don Det, Don Khon, and Khone Phapheng
- [Pakse](https://laos-travelguide.com/pakse/): Base for Wat Phou and the plateau
- [Bolaven Plateau](https://laos-travelguide.com/bolaven-plateau/): Tad Fane and Tad Yuang
- [Nong Khiaw](https://laos-travelguide.com/nong-khiaw/): Viewpoint above the Nam Ou

## Plan
- [Best time to visit](https://laos-travelguide.com/plan/best-time-to-visit/): Cool months and waterfall season
- [Visa and eVisa](https://laos-travelguide.com/plan/visa-and-evisa/): 30-day tourist stay and listed ports
- [Money and SIM](https://laos-travelguide.com/plan/money-and-sim/): Kip, ATMs, and a local SIM
- [Laos-China Railway](https://laos-travelguide.com/get-there/laos-china-railway/): Vientiane to Luang Prabang
- [Bangkok to Laos](https://laos-travelguide.com/get-there/bangkok-to-laos/): Flight or sleeper
- [Hanoi to Laos](https://laos-travelguide.com/get-there/hanoi-to-laos/): Flights to Luang Prabang and Vientiane
- [Lao food](https://laos-travelguide.com/lao-food/): Fifteen dishes to order first
- [7 days](https://laos-travelguide.com/itineraries/7-days/): Luang Prabang to Vientiane
- [10 days](https://laos-travelguide.com/itineraries/10-days/): North first, then Pakse
